description: This file defines the Gitlab OAuth2 provider class, including methods for constructing OAuth URLs, handling responses, and creating user resource objects within the OAuth2 client library.

classes.name: Gitlab
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for Gitlab, handling OAuth flow URLs, response validation, and user resource creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Gitlab provider with options, allowing customization of the domain.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to start the OAuth authorization process.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to obtain an access token.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to fetch user details using the access token.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the scope separator used by Gitlab (' ').

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks the response for errors and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a user resource object from the response data.
